item.title: For first time in decades, SEC weighs new definition for 'small firms'
item.description: The regulator considers raising the AUM threshold it uses when considering how newly proposed rules are likely to affect small RIAs.

item.title: Plan sponsors signal cautious interest in private markets
item.description: Plan sponsors show growing interest in private market investments for 401(k) plans, but regulatory uncertainty, fees and litigation risk continue to slow adoption, a Cerulli study found.

item.title: From wildfires to floods, what advisors learned from recent disasters
item.description: Last January, one of the deadliest and costliest wildfires in modern U.S. History struck, leaving those who survived with hard-won wisdom about how to prepare clients for the next disaster.

item.title: FINRA seeks to extend account holds to combat elder fraud
item.description: A new proposal would allow firms to tack three additional months onto the amount of time they can place holds on the accounts of clients 65 and older in cases of suspected financial exploitation.

item.title: Wells Fargo, Merrill lead a multibillion-dollar week: Advisor Moves
item.description: Wells Fargo lands big teams from Merrill and Citi, while Cerity Partners and Mercer Advisors continue their aggressive M&A streaks.

item.title: Advisors using workarounds as total tech integration still a dream
item.description: Systems still don't talk to each other as well as they should in 2026, so advisors are finding their own solutions.

item.title: NASCAR champ's 'financial trap' insurance case puts IUL under microscope
item.description: Kyle Busch's lawsuit against Pacific Life and his former insurance agent provides a window into potential issues around complexity, suitability and more in indexed universal life policies.

item.title: AI will reshape portfolio construction, say financial advisors
item.description: A Financial Planning survey found that advisors believe AI will continue to transform wealth management. But experts say human oversight is still essential.

item.title: Labor Department backs fiduciaries in 401(k) forfeiture lawsuits
item.description: The Labor Department is siding with plan sponsors in a growing wave of ERISA lawsuits challenging how forfeited 401(k) funds are used.

item.title: Supreme Court to review SEC power to recoup illegal gains
item.description: The justices are scheduled to resolve disagreement among lower courts over whether market regulators can order fraudsters to repay ill-gotten gains to victims.
